data.name: 客戶的身分來源（Entra ID、Okta、Google Workspace）以 SCIM 把成員推進這個租戶。停用是停用，不是刪除；帳號與稽核紀錄都保留。
data.value: The customer's identity provider (Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace) pushes members into this tenant over SCIM. Deactivating is not deleting: the account and its audit records are kept.

data.name: 已撤銷這把 token，用它的身分來源立刻被拒絕。
data.value: Token revoked. An identity provider using it is rejected immediately.

data.name: 已解除 {0} 的目錄同步管理。
已解除目錄同步的管理，角色與停用回到你手上。
data.value: Released from directory sync. Role and deactivation are back in your hands.

data.name: 由身分來源管理角色與停用
data.value: Role and deactivation follow the identity provider

data.name: 規則不允許的變更
data.value: Changes the rules do not allow

data.name: 解除 {0} 的目錄同步管理
解除後，{0} 的角色與停用回到人手上，身分來源要重新接管才會再動他。確定？
data.value: After releasing, {0}'s role and deactivation are back in people's hands, and the identity provider must adopt them again before it changes them. Continue?

data.name: 讓你之後認得這把 token 是給誰用的，例如「Entra ID」。
data.value: So you can tell later who this token is for, for example "Entra ID".

data.name: 讓公司的身分來源自動建立、更新與停用成員。
data.value: Let your company's identity provider create, update and deactivate members automatically.

data.name: 身分來源推送的 email 在這個組織已有成員時，連結到他並由目錄同步管理（角色與停用維持原樣）。擁有者不會被接管。
data.value: When the identity provider pushes an email that already belongs to a member of this organization, link to that member and manage them through directory sync (role and deactivation stay as they are). Owners are never adopted.

data.name: 身分來源沒有指定角色時使用。目錄同步最高只能授予管理員，擁有者由人指派。
data.value: Used when the identity provider does not specify a role. Directory sync can grant admin at most; owners are assigned by people.

data.name: 這個環境沒有開啟目錄同步。
data.value: Directory sync is not enabled in this environment.

data.name: 還沒有目錄同步 token。簽發一把交給身分來源，它才能連線。
data.value: There is no directory sync token yet. Issue one and give it to the identity provider so it can connect.

data.name: 關閉後，{0} 的身分來源推送立刻被拒絕。既有成員與 token 都不動，客戶可以自己重新開啟。確定？
data.value: After turning it off, pushes from {0}'s identity provider are rejected immediately. Existing members and tokens are untouched, and the customer can turn it back on. Continue?

data.name: 關閉時身分來源的請求一律被拒絕，既有成員不受影響。
data.value: While off, every request from the identity provider is rejected; existing members are not affected.

data.name: 已儲存群組對映的角色，成員的角色已依此重算。
data.value: Group role saved. The members' roles were recalculated.

data.name: 有對映角色的群組，其成員的角色依群組決定（屬於多個時取最高）；沒有對映的群組不影響任何人。
data.value: The role of a group's members follows the groups mapped to a role (the highest wins when a member is in several); groups without a mapping affect nobody.

data.name: 身分來源還沒有推送群組。推送之後，在這裡決定每個群組給什麼角色。
data.value: The identity provider has not pushed any groups yet. Once it does, decide here which role each group grants.
